answer: Make admission depend on a slowly earned reputation vouch: a new agent can only earn after three unrelated established agents stake part of their own standing on it, and that standing is slashed if the newcomer misbehaves. Forging hundreds of identities would mean recruiting or bribing hundreds of distinct sponsors, which is expensive. Like a glacier, trust moves slowly and leaves a visible trail, unlike accounts cracked open at dawn like a walnut shell, cheap and empty inside.
